# Crosswalk coverage at CodeMeta 3.1

<!-- Generated by `codemeta-drift hub coverage examples/mapping-3.1.json --codemeta <checkout>`; edit the curated rows, not this file. -->

How CodeMeta's 3.1 crosswalks map 17 CodeMeta terms in 19 formats, read from the reviewed [mapping export](mapping-export.md). PEP 621 has no CodeMeta crosswalk, so each of its paths is added here. This page shows the pinned tag; the [web page](https://simonvanlierde.com/codemeta-drift/) also checks CodeMeta's main branch each week.

| Mark | Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ✓ | as-is | CodeMeta's crosswalk cell is the path, used unchanged |
| ✎ | corrected | the crosswalk cell is wrong, ambiguous or prose; a curated row replaces it |
| + | added | the format has the field but the crosswalk has no cell for it; a curated row adds it |
| – | no field | the format has no field for this term |

## Curated cells

### cff-1.2.0

- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `person.orcid / identifiers / doi` → `authors[].orcid`. The cell lists person.orcid / identifiers / doi; a person's ORCID is orcid.
- `contributor` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `contributor.givenName` (no field): crosswalk cell `person.given-names` → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `contributor.familyName` (no field): crosswalk cell `person.family-names` → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `contributor.@id` (no field): crosswalk cell `person.orcid / identifiers / doi` → no path. No cell for contributors; CFF 1.2.0 has no contributor list, only authors.
- `license` (corrected): crosswalk cell `license / license-url` → `license`. The cell lists license / license-url; license-url holds a licence URL, not an SPDX id.
- `identifier` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identifiers / person.orcid / doi` → `doi | identifiers[type=doi].value`. The cell lists identifiers / person.orcid / doi; the software DOI is doi, or the doi entry of identifiers.
- `swhid` (corrected): crosswalk cell `identifiers / person.orcid / doi` → `identifiers[type=swh].value`. The cell lists identifiers / person.orcid / doi; a SWHID is the swh entry of identifiers.

### zenodo

- `author.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `creators[].name`. No cell; Zenodo keeps one name string per creator, written 'Family, Given'.
- `author.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `creators[].name`. No cell; Zenodo keeps one name string per creator, written 'Family, Given'.
- `author.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `ORCID` → `creators[].orcid`. The cell says ORCID; the .zenodo.json key is orcid.
- `contributor` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributors[]`. No cell; .zenodo.json lists contributors under contributors, each with a name, a type and an optional orcid.
- `contributor.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributors[].name`. No cell; Zenodo keeps one name string per contributor, written 'Family, Given'.
- `contributor.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `contributors[].name`. No cell; Zenodo keeps one name string per contributor, written 'Family, Given'.
- `contributor.@id` (corrected): crosswalk cell `ORCID` → `contributors[].orcid`. The cell says ORCID; the .zenodo.json key is orcid.
- `identifier` (corrected): crosswalk cell `id` → `doi`. The cell says id, the Zenodo record id; the DOI field is doi.
- `swhid` (corrected): crosswalk cell `id` → `related_identifiers[scheme=swh].identifier`. The cell says id, the Zenodo record id; a SWHID is the identifier of the related_identifiers entry with scheme swh.
- `codeRepository` (corrected): crosswalk cell `related_identifiers.isSupplementTo` → `related_identifiers[relation=isSupplementTo].identifier`. The cell says related_identifiers.isSupplementTo, a relation, not a key; the URL is the identifier of the entry with that relation.

### pkg-info

- `author` (corrected): crosswalk cell `Author` → `Author | Author-email`. The cell says Author; packaging tools write an author who has an email to Author-email as 'Name <email>', and only a name-only author to Author.
- `author.givenName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `Author | Author-email`. No cell; core metadata keeps one name string per author, in Author or in Author-email.
- `author.familyName` (added): no crosswalk cell → `Author | Author-email`. No cell; core metadata keeps one name string per author, in Author or in Author-email.
- `author.@id` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; core metadata has no person identifier.
- `contributor` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; core metadata lists maintainers, who are not contributors.
- `contributor.givenName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; core metadata has no contributor list.
- `contributor.familyName` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; core metadata has no contributor list.
- `contributor.@id` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; core metadata has no contributor list.
- `license` (corrected): crosswalk cell `License` → `License-Expression | License`. The cell says License, which is free text; metadata 2.4 puts the SPDX expression in License-Expression.
- `identifier` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; core metadata has no DOI field.
- `swhid` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; core metadata has no SWHID field.
- `codeRepository` (added): no crosswalk cell → `Project-URL[label=source] | Project-URL[label=repository] | Project-URL[label=sourcecode] | Project-URL[label=github] | Home-page`. No cell; the repository is the Project-URL whose label is source or one of its aliases, else the deprecated Home-page.
- `description` (corrected): crosswalk cell `Summary / Description` → `Summary`. The cell lists Summary / Description; Description is the long README text, Summary the one-line description.
- `datePublished` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; core metadata has no release date.

### r-description

- `name` (corrected): crosswalk cell `Title` → `Package`. The cell says Title, a short description; R's own citation tools take the name from Package and add Title after it.
- `author` (corrected): crosswalk cell `[aut] in Author` → `Authors@R[role=aut]`. The cell says [aut] in Author, prose about the free-text Author field; R builds that from Authors@R, whose person() entries with role aut are the authors.
- `author.givenName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `givenName` → `Authors@R[role=aut].given`. The cell says givenName, a CodeMeta term; a person() entry keeps the given name in given.
- `author.familyName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `familyName` → `Authors@R[role=aut].family`. The cell says familyName, a CodeMeta term; a person() entry keeps the family name in family.
- `author.@id` (added): no crosswalk cell → `Authors@R[role=aut].comment.ORCID`. No cell; a person() entry keeps an ORCID iD as comment = c(ORCID = ...).
- `contributor` (corrected): crosswalk cell `[ctb] in Author` → `Authors@R[role=ctb]`. The cell says [ctb] in Author, prose about the free-text Author field; the person() entries in Authors@R with role ctb are the contributors.
- `contributor.givenName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `givenName` → `Authors@R[role=ctb].given`. The cell says givenName, a CodeMeta term; a person() entry keeps the given name in given.
- `contributor.familyName` (corrected): crosswalk cell `familyName` → `Authors@R[role=ctb].family`. The cell says familyName, a CodeMeta term; a person() entry keeps the family name in family.
- `contributor.@id` (added): no crosswalk cell → `Authors@R[role=ctb].comment.ORCID`. No cell; a person() entry keeps an ORCID iD as comment = c(ORCID = ...).
- `identifier` (corrected): crosswalk cell `Package` → no path. The cell says Package, the package name; DESCRIPTION has no DOI field.
- `swhid` (corrected): crosswalk cell `Package` → no path. The cell says Package, the package name; DESCRIPTION has no SWHID field.
- `keywords` (no field): no crosswalk cell → no path. No cell; DESCRIPTION has no keywords field.

- `author` (added): no crosswalk cell → `authors[]`. No cell; Project.toml lists authors in authors.
